title: Re: Tomb Looters - Level 2
description: Re: Tomb Looters - Level 2 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Ticked Tomb Curator

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Enter the Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist off of Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag, slay 10 Looters there, and return to the Ticked Tomb Curator in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Ticked Tomb Curator

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Enter the Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist off of Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag, slay 10 Looters there, and return to the Ticked Tomb Curator in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

Despite your efforts to keep them out of the tomb the Looters have not relented and even now they are back in the tomb getting their filthy paws all over that sacred monument. I can't stand it, knowing that those monsters are in there desecrating a tomb of one of my favorite Dungeon Runners! I am so furious I am about to pick up a two-hand guitar axe and head in there right now, and I would if this character wasn't a mule for my primary character! But, alas, that is why Gosh has seen fit to deliver you to me. Will you help me again to rid the tomb of the Looters?

Head into Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag then into the Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist. When you are there slay 10 of the Looters and then return to me, the Ticked Tomb Curator, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell. Maybe, to send a message to the other Looters, you should loot the corpses of the ones you have bested in combat. Oh...oh, you do that already...of course you do. Everyone knows that...ahem.

Turn-in:

You did it? Huzzah! Perhaps you want to go ahead and just do it again real quick?

Objectives:

  • Slay Looters

Client level range: 78–81
